resources.string: Use the menu to switch between Sub and Dom. Dom access requires unlocking. Switching preserves settings and any active session.
Manage a selected Sub’s Contract and Tasks from the Dom workspace.
Select This device for local controls or a connected Sub for their controls. Each Sub has a separate Contract and Tasks.
These pages preview Dom controls. Unlock Dom separately to use them. While a remote Dom controls this device, local authentication is for recovery and unpairing.
